name: Tainted Keg
summary: The Tainted Keg is a barrel of stolen dwarven stout laced with a lethal Forsaken brew concocted by Apothecary Lydon. Delivered under the guise of refreshments to imprisoned human farmers in Tarren Mill, it serves as a gruesome field test for the Royal Apothecary Society's developing poisons.

sections.title: A Deadly Vintage
sections.body: The keg began its existence as a barrel of Shindigger Stout, plundered from the dwarven riflemen entrenched at Dun Garok. Rather than drinking it, Apothecary Lydon contaminated the hearty ale with his newly refined Elixir of Agony. By lacing an ordinary beverage, the Forsaken crafted an insidious vector designed to slip past suspicion, turning a familiar comforts of the living into a swift death sentence.

sections.title: Testing on the Condemned
sections.body: Held upstairs in the Tarren Mill inn, several human farmers were captured after High Executor Darthalia suspected a Stormwind military strategist had hidden among them. When word arrived that the strategist had perished elsewhere, the captive laborers became expendable. Darthalia handed them over to Lydon, who staged a cruel celebration by having the poisoned keg placed on the rug in their holding room. Parched and desperate, the prisoners drank freely, proving the elixir's immediate, fatal potency.

faq.q: What is inside the Tainted Keg?
aliases: what poison is in the keg
faq.answer: It contains Shindigger Stout—a rich dwarven ale stolen from Dun Garok—mixed with the Elixir of Agony, an experimental toxin created by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Where did the ale originally come from?
aliases: where was the stout stolen from
faq.answer: The base brew was taken from the dwarven mountaineers and riflemen occupying Dun Garok, a heavily defended dwarven fortress situated in southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills.
A group of human farmers held hostage in the upstairs room of the Tarren Mill inn drink from the barrel, collapsing and dying almost instantly from the tainted brew.

faq.q: Why were the farmers being held prisoner?
aliases: why are farmers in tarren mill
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia arrested them under suspicion that an Alliance military strategist from Stormwind was hiding in their ranks. Once that strategist was confirmed dead in the Plaguelands, the captive farmers were deemed useless and handed to the apothecaries.

angles.text: For the Royal Apothecary Society, the tainted stout is a practical milestone in engineering biological weapons capable of eradicating humanity.
The slaughter of captured rural laborers by laced ale shows the harrowing, merciless tactics facing the living remnants throughout Hillsbrad.
